# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-high

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Two agents, one feature each, with messaging and a shared git remote, using `gemini-3-flash-preview` at `high` thinking. Budgets are the upstream defaults (100 steps, compaction at 28K). It completes the comparison of thinking levels for this model in `coop --git` and compares it with `gemini-3.8-flash` at `high` (3/10).

## Observations

- 4/10, the same as at `minimal` (4/10). As at every thinking level for this model, `coop --git` scored below `solo` (5/10 at `high`).
- 3 pairs had merge conflicts (`openai_tiktoken_task/0`, `pallets_click_task/2800`, `typst_task/6554`) and 7 merged cleanly. All 20 agents pushed work, and 4 of 20 reached the step limit.
- Agents sent 15 messages per pair, about the same as at `minimal`.
- Caveat: 61 calls were retried because of the API rate limit; retries can make a partner give up waiting for a reply.
